title: Sorting Floating Point Slices
goal: Sort a slice of float values using partial_cmp.

source.attribution: adapted from Day 4 Morning: Standard Traits

hints: `[f64]` does not implement `Ord`, so `.sort()` is unavailable.
Use `.sort_by` with `partial_cmp` and fall back when `partial_cmp` returns `None`.
explanation: Slices of floating-point numbers do not implement `.sort()` because `f64` lacks the `Ord` trait due to `NaN`. Using `.sort_by` allows custom comparison logic using `.partial_cmp(b)`. Calling `.unwrap_or(Ordering::Equal)` handles any `None` values caused by `NaN`, providing a fallback ordering that compiles safely.
